nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Bayesian Linear Regression with likelihood warping (sinarcsinsh warping function) was used.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) with likelihood warping was used ... We used a 'sinarcsinsh' warping function ... equivalent to the SHASH distribution
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness, subcortical volume, and surface area from Freesurfer; Resting-state functional connectivity from Yeo-17 and Smith-10 atlases.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Estimates of cortical thickness and subcortical volume were then extracted ... We also share models of surface area ... normative models of brain functional connectivity (resting- state brain networks, Yeo- 17 and Smith- 10)
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Image preprocessing and Normative model formulation

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age (modeled with cubic spline basis expansion for non-linear effects), Sex, Site, Euler number (structural), Mean Framewise Displacement (functional).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The covariates used to train the structural normative models included age, sex, data quality metric (Euler number), and site. ... functional normative models ... included age, sex, data quality metric (mean framewise displacement), and site. ... consisting of a B- spline basis expansion (cubic spline with 5 evenly spaced knots) to model non- linear effects of age
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation & Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling
